description: Dashboard data API. FastAPI port 8783. Endpoints: GET /dashboard/summary (total servers, breakdown by verdict, breakdown by risk_tier, avg trust_score, last_scan_time, pipeline_health counts), GET /dashboard/recent (last 20 build events from mesh_events), GET /dashboard/top_risks (top 10 servers by risk_rank from mcp_risk_register JOIN mcp_server_registry), GET /dashboard/trends (verdict distribution last 7 days grouped by date), GET /health. All queries via ws_query. Daemon with uvicorn port 8783. Heartbeat.
